description_en: Retrieves driver configurations of an edge instance in batches
description_zh: 批量获取边缘实例驱动配置
kebab_example: aliyun iot batch-get-edge-instance-driver-configs --iot-instance-id iot_instc_pu0000_c0-v6400000000 --instance-id F3APY0tPLhmgGtx00000 --driver-ids example-string --api-version 2018-01-20 --region cn-hangzhou
name: BatchGetEdgeInstanceDriverConfigs

parameters.description_en: The instance ID. Leave this parameter empty for public instances. Specify this parameter for Enterprise instances.
parameters.description_zh: 实例ID。公共实例不传此参数，企业版实例需传入。
parameters.help_en: The instance ID. Leave this parameter empty for public instances. Specify this parameter for Enterprise instances
parameters.help_zh: 实例ID。公共实例不传此参数，企业版实例需传入
parameters.name: iot_instance_id

parameters.description_en:
Instance ID of the edge instance. On the **Edge Instances** page of the [IoT Platform console](https://iot.console.aliyun.com/le/instance/list), hover over the target edge instance name to obtain instance ID.

You can also call the [QueryEdgeInstance](~~135214~~) operation to obtain instance ID.
parameters.description_zh:
边缘实例ID。在[边缘计算控制台](https://iot.console.aliyun.com/le/instance/list)的**边缘实例**页面中，鼠标悬浮在目标边缘实例名称上获取ID。

您也可以调用[QueryEdgeInstance](~~135214~~)接口获取。

parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.description_en:
The list of driver IDs to query. On the **Driver Management** page of the [IoT Platform console](https://iot.console.aliyun.com/le/instance/list), hover over the target driver name to obtain the ID.

You can also call the [QueryEdgeDriver](~~155776~~) operation to obtain the ID.

> You can specify up to 20 driver IDs. This means you can retrieve configurations of up to 20 drivers in a single batch.
parameters.description_zh:
要查询的驱动ID列表。在[边缘计算控制台](https://iot.console.aliyun.com/le/instance/list)的**驱动管理**页面中，鼠标悬浮在目标驱动名称上获取ID。

您也可以调用[QueryEdgeDriver](~~155776~~)接口获取。

> 最多可传入20个驱动ID，即最多可批量获取20个驱动的配置。
